issues.failure_explanation: Nothing in the definition guarantees \(\L_{\mathrm{ent}}\ge0\). For example, if \(f=0\), \(v(t)=A-t\), and \(A-T>c\), then \(v-k_h>0\) for every \(k_h\in V_h^c\), so every entropy integral equals \(-|\Omega_T|\). Thus the total loss can be smaller than both \(\L_{bc}\) and \(\L_{reg}\). The repeatedly used inequalities \(\L_{reg}\le\L\) and \(\L_{bc}\le\L\) are therefore invalid, and minimization can exploit cancellation by a negative entropy term.
